readings: Considering only films whose allowed rental duration (`film.rental_duration`) is at least 5 days, group them by original language (`film.original_language_id`), treating films with no original language as one group of their own, and for each group work out the average rental rate (`rental_rate`) and the number of films. Then, across those groups, what is the average of the group average rental rates and the average of the group film counts? Treat each group equally, ignore missing values (missing if none remain), return the two figures in that order as a single row, and don't round.
queries:
SELECT AVG(avg_rate), AVG(film_count)
FROM (
  SELECT AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rate, COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film
  WHERE rental_duration >= 5
  GROUP BY COALESCE(original_language_id, -1)
);
